name: Nell's Night
source:
Nell is a college hermit with all of the worst qualities.

Social anxiety. Overanalyzing. Agoraphobia... The list goes on.

She'd rather do homework than hang out with friends.

She never goes out.

But tonight, she does.

[From [url=https://angelsera.itch.io/nells-night]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
内尔是一位大学隐士，具有所有最糟糕的品质。

社交焦虑。过度分析。广场恐惧症……这样的例子不胜枚举。

她宁愿做作业也不愿和朋友出去玩。

她从不出门。

但今晚，她做到了。

[来自[url=https://angelsera.itch.io/nells-night]itch.io[/url]]
